## Problem and change

State the problem and the resulting behavior.
Link the related issue, if there is one.

## Checks

List the checks you ran and their results.
State which checks remain untested.
Separate live desktop checks from automated tests.

## Sources and limits

State any known third-party sources and required notices.
State how you reviewed AI output, if you used it.
Describe any relevant input, platform, or recovery limits.

- [ ] The PR contains no tokens, private profiles, private captures, or local logs.
- [ ] The affected guides and tests match the change.

The maintainer reviews changes as time and project needs permit.
A PR does not guarantee acceptance. No DCO sign-off is required.
